quest.title: To Gaze Upon the Dreaming Pale Crown
quest.description: According to the directions from the Eye of Graeae, one of the fragments of his power is located behind Zapolyarny Palace, where the Tsar's White Birch grows...

chapter.title: Palaces on one side, mausoleums on the other

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: ...The formula is perfect. I'm sure Grand Duke Alvis will praise the results of my hard work over the last few days upon his return.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's... Let's rest here for a little while. Whew...

talks.objective: Talk to the Eye of Graeae

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's so cold out there... The train's definitely much cozier...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: That is precisely why the trains exist. Trekking long distances through such bitter cold would hardly be good for anyone's health.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Perhaps that, too, was my creator's original purpose in establishing it... After all, this land of ice and snow is hardly a place fit for humans to survive.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your creator...? Ah, could that be the strange woman we ran into earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How rude! What do you mean, "strange woman"!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon definitely doesn't mean the strange woman you're talking about right now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...You know, the one who appeared in that mumbly-jumbly town with the firebird, and in that castle full of Snegovik. Paimon remembers her name was Ak...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Miss Aksinya, yes. Judging from the memories I have recovered so far, she was once a member of the Belyi Tsar's research organization, the Aly{RUBY#[S]Hvergelmir}pium...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: She created me so that I might... guide a certain mighty power, and create a "Tomorrow" — a world where no one would ever suffer again...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: A land that has cast aside envy, hatred, and selfish desire. A "Courtyard of Carefree Light" held aloft by the hands of all living beings. Thus...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: "Thus shall a radiant world descend, where there will be no distinction between human and human, nor between human and god."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A world where there's no distinction between humans and gods? Hmm... Paimon can't even imagine how you'd make that happen...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: "A pure world of mankind, where gods need not wield divine power, and humans need not rely on gods."

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: ...That is the outcome of the plan, as I remember it.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: But as for how it was to be accomplished... I'm sorry, but I do not know the full scope of the final plan. To the plan as a whole, I was nothing more than a "tool" within it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon gets it! Goggles is like a crafting bench. It can craft all kinds of amazing things, but a crafting bench doesn't run around eating up its own materials.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: That is a very apt analogy. However, if I may, Miss Paimon, in present-day Snezhnaya, alchemy is not an officially supported field of study...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: R-Right... But, well, we're on our own train, so...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: ...But should I truly seek out the final power?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: What if, after obtaining that last portion of power, the memories that return are not the ones I wished to recover? What should I do then?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: What if... What if that's the only reason I was created, the purpose I was destined for...?

choices.text: Then don't decide yet. Wait until you remember.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! It's definitely not good to decide when you don't know anything yet. No matter what, you've gotta remember everything first!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway... Goggles has helped us out a lot! Even if that wasn't what Goggles was originally created for, Goggles has still been really useful to us!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: When that time comes, just come back to us.

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: ...Is that so?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, we already talked about all the things we're going to do together when you get your body back! Warming up by the fire, having snowball fights, running around on the ice fields... We promised!

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: Yes. I look forward to... adventuring together with you both after I recover my body.

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: Though I have thought this countless times throughout our journey... I am truly glad that you were the one to bring me out of that place, and that I was able to meet you both.

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: The final power... all the answers are there. At the final resting place of the previous Tsar of Ice — the one known as the Belyi Tsar...

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: I have marked the location on your map.

choices.text: What's wrong with a crafting bench wanting to craft!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! And if anyone's to blame, it's whoever misused the crafting bench!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wah, this is all your fault... Now Paimon can't stop imagining a crafting bench going "huff, huff" like some kind of dog!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Friends, we were created for a single moment, \nTo call back those dreams flickering on the verge of extinction, to...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hmm... Where... am I?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Wait... wasn't I just... on the train?)
Izmaylo... Izmaylo. Hah, spacing out again, are we? We need to keep watch on the thing inside the egg at all times, remember?

dialogues.speaker: Izmaylov
dialogues.text: I wasn't spacing out... And the Proto-Man is in a highly stable state. Even in the gloom of the Font of the Shadow Realm, he shines as brilliantly as a pearl.
Then you weren't spacing out. You were worried.

dialogues.speaker: Izmaylov
dialogues.text: You are right, Azazel. There is too much to think about.

dialogues.speaker: Azazel
dialogues.text: There is no need for such concern. Your teacher, Miss Aksinya, remained quite composed upon hearing of His Majesty the Tsar's passing... Oh, are you worried about something else?

dialogues.speaker: Izmaylov
dialogues.text: The newly ascended Tsaritsa. It is her attitude that concerns me...

dialogues.speaker: Azazel
dialogues.text: Her attitude toward those fae nobles wallowing in Mora and decadence? I doubt it's anything favorable.

dialogues.speaker: Izmaylov
dialogues.text: I mean her attitude toward the Alypium...

dialogues.speaker: Izmaylov
dialogues.text: After all, our research has crossed into forbidden territory. The only reason we were allowed to continue before was His Majesty's tacit approval and protection. But our new Tsaritsa...

dialogues.speaker: Izmaylov
dialogues.text: Well, I've heard certain things.

dialogues.speaker: Azazel
dialogues.text: What kind of things?

dialogues.speaker: Izmaylov
dialogues.text: They're planning to ban anything related to alchemy. The Alypium has plenty of bio-alchemy projects, so it's obvious those would be shut down. And if that happens...

dialogues.speaker: Izmaylov
dialogues.text: His Majesty's final aspiration will never be realized.

dialogues.speaker: Azazel
dialogues.text: Perhaps that would be for the best. Have you forgotten what happened during the last experiment? And besides, His Majesty, in the end, also... Never mind...

dialogues.speaker: Izmaylov
dialogues.text: ...You are right, Azazel. But I still need to think this through.

dialogues.speaker: Azazel
dialogues.text: Don't dwell on it, Izmaylo. It's not our call to make. Besides... the higher-ups are meeting today.

dialogues.speaker: Azazel
dialogues.text: Once they've decided what to do, they'll inform us.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Is this... a Shadow Realm? Paimon and the Eye of Graeae are gone...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (...There are two people up ahead. Maybe I should try talking to them.)

dialogues.speaker: Izmaylov
dialogues.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Azazel
dialogues.text: Something wrong, my dear Izmaylo? You'd be even better company if you didn't get distracted so easily.

dialogues.speaker: Izmaylov
dialogues.text: *sigh* I keep feeling like someone's watching us... But when I look back, there's no one there.

dialogues.speaker: Azazel
dialogues.text: Haha, Izmaylo. Maybe you should keep your eyes on what matters.

dialogues.speaker: Azazel
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, Mr. Koshchei seems to have left in a hurry and forgotten to close his office door. Well, never mind. Once we're done recording the data, I'll close it for him.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (They can't see me... That's strange. Something feels off, like I don't quite belong here.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (But I'm not feeling too uncomfortable. Hmm... Maybe I should take a look around first...)

talks.objective: Go to the place that the Eye of Graeae showed you

dialogues.speaker: Cat
dialogues.text: Meow... Meow...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (It looks like it's starving... But according to what Pavlina said earlier, it won't eat unless the food is placed in its bowl...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Too bad. There doesn't seem to be a food bowl nearby...)

talks.objective: Go to the place that the Eye of Graeae showed you
Find a path into the mountains
Find a path into the mountains

dialogues.text: ...The formula is perfect. I'm sure Grand Duke Alvis will praise the results of my hard work over the last few days upon his return.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Let's... Let's rest here for a little while. Whew...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (The door's shut... If I can find some way to...)

dialogues.speaker: Weak Meow
dialogues.text: Meow...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (...Oh, there's your food bowl.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (All right, all right. Let's get you fed first, poor thing...)

talks.objective: Advance into the snowstorm

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that is...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Yes. That's where we're going... The Belyi Tsar's private palace outside Snezhnograd.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Pale Crown Palace.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: There, the graceful Snegurochka once played the gusli in the palace royal hall, while waterborn fae sang along to the ethereal melody, chanting the name of the king who ruled the snowfields.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Valiant beasts clashed endlessly before the throne, vying for the Tsar's favor, while domovoy searched far and wide for rare treasures and riches, all to fill the palace vault.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... T-Treasure vault?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Yes. Though by now, I'm afraid it has long since been emptied.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: They say... that was where the great king showed mercy. There, he accepted humankind and allowed them to come before him...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: To help the frail, pitiful humans of that time carve out a place of their own amid the ice and snow, the flame of Kresnik was first kindled in that palace, then spread far and wide.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: And so, unlike in the days of the Pale Star's royal court, this eternally frozen land no longer belonged to the fae alone. It became a land shared by humans and fae...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: And he renamed it Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... So that's how Snezhnaya came to be. Paimon always thought the Tsaritsa founded it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, how does Goggles know so much about this place?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Of course. I was created here, in a hidden chamber within this palace...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: The place we mentioned before, the Alypium... Though even that is only one corner of the palace's shadow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, wow... If this palace was so impressive, why does it feel so cold and deserted now?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Because five hundred years ago, the Belyi Tsar died fighting the Abyss and the tides of beasts. His remains were brought back here...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: And after he was laid to rest, part of his body became the "White Birch Tsar." Since then, the Tsaritsa has ruled Snezhnaya from Zapolyarny Palace, and no one has returned here since.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... where we're going is actually the Belyi Tsar's... tomb?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Yes, Miss Paimon. The Belyi Tsar's tomb — but also the place where I was created.

choices.text: Wait, this isn't against the rules, is it?

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: ...The authorities advise against entering without permission. But officially, it is not strictly forbidden.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not strictly forbidden? Then that means we're strictly allowed to sneak in!

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: Then again... getting put on a wanted list could be interesting.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, no thanks... Okay, Paimon knows what to do. If we get caught by some Snezhnayan guards...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon will just say the guiding mechanism sent us the wrong way and we got lost! Getting lost isn't illegal, right? Yep, that's our story.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... the train tracks are broken. What are we gonna do?

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: It's all right. That route was only ever meant to mislead people. It was never the real way into the Pale Crown Palace.

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: Think of it as a marker, telling ordinary pilgrims and those visiting in remembrance that they should go no farther.

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: If we really mean to cross over, we'll need to find... the mechanism that activates the "hidden tracks."

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: I can sense it. The mechanism that summons the "hidden tracks" should be up on that tower.

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: But the tower appears to be encircled by the "White Birch Tsar." We'll have to find another way in...

choices.text: We're not going to get caught and end up on a wanted list, are we?

talks.objective: Find the mechanism for the "hidden tracks"
Find the mechanism for the "hidden tracks"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... Paimon had no idea all this was underneath that giant tree...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that... a palace?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: That's odd... Why, all of a sudden...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Goggles, what's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: I told you before... that I could sense the power that once belonged to me had been split into three parts. One of them was hidden away in a deeper darkness beyond my perception.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: But now, maybe because we're closer, I can feel it... The power I couldn't sense before is right here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Yes. It is right here... within the Pale Crown Palace before us...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Pale Crown Palace?

talks.objective: Summon the "hidden tracks"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Goggles, you're amazing! Is there any train you can't drive?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: ...Not exactly. For some reason, the trains currently running in Snezhnaya only keep their power systems, leaving no room for remote control.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: These early prototypes, though, still have control interfaces...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... Is... that... so...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: That... is true... However...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: However... What...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you mean that...!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Strange... Why is Paimon speaking so slowly...?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (No, wait... Huh? Is it me?)

talks.objective: Wait for the train to approach

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (A giant egg... in the middle of the Shadow Realm...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Is something inside it? Could that be the "Proto-Man" they mentioned earlier?)

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: (A note, written in an elegant hand...)

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I will be returning to the House of Hesperides for the next few days, so I'll leave the cat in your care. I can hardly trust the others with her, given how absorbed they become in their experiments."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I am sure my colleague Koshchei shares my respect for living things and will remember to feed my Lala... The key and specially prepared cat food are on your shelf."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "...And remember, my Lala only eats from her bowl. Please don't scatter her food on the floor. She won't eat anything off the floor."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "P.S. If I find that my cat has not been properly fed, or that she has somehow grown parts from another animal, I will find out who is responsible. — Pavlina"

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Notes
dialogues.text: (A note, written in a cold, stiff hand with almost no variation...)

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: "...The prisoners used as experimental material have already been handed over to Alvis. There is no doubt that the results of that experiment were 'incorrect.'"

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: "But is that what humans... Is that what loveless fae should seek as 'love'? Perhaps the Snegovik, incomplete in spirit as they are, truly could make use of this technology..."

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: "To gain the 'love' they lacked from the beginning. Just as... just as 'he' told me, dreams that are too grand have no meaning. Perhaps..."

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: "Perhaps 'he' was right. That power... That power should have been ours from the start, as compensation. It was never meant to belong to Aksinya's aberrant dream."

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: "...I will stop here before Alvis 'accidentally' comes across this again and causes more trouble."

talks.objective: Find the source of the cat cries
Find a way out of the room
Find a way out of the room

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (A set of scales... There's a feather on the left pan, and something is supposed to go on the right...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (This looks like some kind of ritual. The feather is probably just there to represent something "as light as nothing." What matters is the right side... Something real, but with the same weight as "nothing.")

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (The things on the table are...)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (This liquid is giving off a strange glow...)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (No, this shouldn't be on the other side of the scales.)

response.speaker: Player

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (...Looks like nothing I put there will work for this ritual. Maybe there's another meaning behind the words in that note.)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ("Separated, everything is not the cause. For everything to be everything, what was divided must be gathered back into one?")

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (I should try... combining something together.)

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: "Cast off the soul of the past, and it shall no longer be bound by the hidden veins of the planet." "Cast off the will of the past, and it shall no longer be watched by the gaze above." "Cast off the body of the past, and it shall no longer be worn away by the toil and turmoil of the mortal world."

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Following the note's instructions, you grind the yellow crystal and Kresnik Kristall ore into powder and add them to the reagent bottle.\nThen...\nA new substance begins to form.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (A strange reagent... Even when I hold it in my hand, it doesn't feel like it weighs anything. Is it because...)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (This substance, by nature, "transcends" ordinary concepts?)

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text:
"It worked... This reagent has the exact same properties as the (...) that once reduced Kitezhgrad to ruin."
You hear a piercing voice echo through the room.
"This is the way to transcendence in this world — restoration and reversal."
"All "humans" came from (...). With this power in my hands, I can become like them. I can create... I can even command it all..."

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: "'He' didn't lie to me. The man in the egg... 'He' was right. I just need a way. I need to get 'Him,' even one fragment would be enough..."\n"Your Majesty, this should be mine, shouldn't it? I, Alvis, deserve this muxh!"\n"'His' power is perfect. 'He' is the answer I've spent so long searching for. I simply must have 'him'..."

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: They'll be absolutely stunned to learn that I can upload your consciousness here, fully intact, using ancient Hyperborean technology.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Impressive technology indeed. Very well. Let's call this lightweight, portable device the "Eye of Graeae."
...That's what these goggles are called? But they're blue... Uh, anyway, this feels really weird. I can't feel my arms or legs at all.
Now that I'm inside this tiny little device, I can barely feel... my own body.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Is that Aksinya... from the past? And the one speaking to her is... the Eye of Graeae from the past?)

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: That's to be expected. Your consciousness may have been uploaded into these goggles, but your body is still what sustains your power and your existence.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: After all, your body is the true key to opening the new world.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: As that "key," you are already a perfect work of creation. If only... if only we could have gone further...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: But His Majesty... What a pity.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Part of my body once belonged to His Majesty. Sometimes, through fragments of his consciousness, I can see what he once saw. That's how I know...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: If all goes smoothly, you will carry on his will and bring his grand design to completion... He would surely be pleased.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: "Only you can make me laugh so freely, Aksinya." That's what he would say, and he would mean every word. Not like when he speaks to that "Professor," with all those hollow pleasantries.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: A "Royal Jester" gives everything to bring joy to her lord. That is her duty.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: "Royal Jester" was merely a nominal title His Majesty gave you so you could come and go from the palace. It was only meant to keep people from resenting a human for being in His favor. You don't have to...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: I don't see anything wrong with the title. There's nothing laughable about it. Even now, it still has its uses.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Perhaps I could use it to gain entry to Zapolyarny Palace and speak with the newly crowned Tsaritsa... Though by the time I came to court, she had long since departed...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Perhaps she will understand His Majesty's will...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Yes, Aksinya.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: I should show you to my colleagues, just as you are now. Perhaps then, they'll admit that every line of research has its worth. At the very least, Alvis will stand by me.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Perhaps they will help me carry this great cause forward...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Though I know our ideals do not align, all differences will ultimately return to a single path. In the end, true understanding will come.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: They will help me, won't they?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: ...Yes, Aksinya, they will.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Yeah.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: This is the only thing I can do for him, and the only meaning my life has ever had.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: I must have the "Proto-Man," have "you"... No, I beg "you." Please, take the place His Majesty was meant to hold in the original plan...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Please, become the ruler of this planet.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Ah... For a grand undertaking like this, why should I need anyone else's approval or support? Maybe I can carry on the final experiment on my own...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A grand vision, yes. But then what?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: No... How could you...? Can't you see...?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: This is... such a terrible betrayal... Alvis, Koshchei, Pavlina...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: You've forgotten... why we came here. Forgotten that grand, radiant vision...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: You’ve forgotten... the grace he gave us, the glory he granted us. You...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: You cast me out, but no matter. I will return... no matter how long I have to spend in that Shadow Realm beyond beginning and end.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: I cannot understand. Why... why would you destroy the grand undertaking we were meant to build, just for your own selfish reasons? Why would you turn away from the path we were meant to follow?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text:
...This cannot be how it all ends. 
"Even now, I don't hate them. I just feel sorry for them." 
You hear someone say this. At some point, she has appeared, watching her past self fall into shadow. 
"But everything will get back on the right path eventually. Like light passing through different mediums — it may look like it's taking a crooked path, but in truth, it's always taking the fastest, best one."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text:
...Have you forgotten, friends? We were created for a single moment, 
To call back those dreams flickering on the verge of extinction, 
To let the phantom-like children of daylight lead us into "Tomorrow," 
Where we would laugh and spin, circling the sole seat upon the court of the stars, and build—

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Build a pure nation, a homeland born from everyone's love. \nBuild what would become— \nA carefree courtyard for humanity alone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, {NICKNAME}! Are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sat down, and then just froze up all of a sudden...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: I did sense a slight disturbance in your mind, but your physical readings didn't change at all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (You tell them about what you saw in the Shadow Realm...)

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: ...There have been experimental reports of certain Shadow Realms affecting only the mind, while leaving the body in the "Physical Plane" untouched.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: But such cases are exceedingly rare.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} is always seeing weird stuff out of nowhere!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...So, you saw that... place or whatever from five hundred years ago?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: The Alypium.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You saw the Alypium from five hundred years ago, and Goggles from the past, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #So, Goggles, does any of what {NICKNAME} saw sound familiar?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: ...My apologies. I do not remember much of what happened back then.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: I cannot even clearly recall... that such an argument, or such a conversation, took place before I entered the Shadow Realm.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I see...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But that means we can confirm Goggles really did have a body before, right?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: #Yes. Based on what {NICKNAME} heard in that conversation... that does put me much more at ease.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe Goggles' body is still somewhere in the center of the Alypium, just waiting for him!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Th-Then the last piece must be in the center of the Alypium...

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: I hope so. Then I may be able to remember more... and return to my original body sooner.

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: We will soon be arriving at the Pale Crown Palace. Please be mindful of any jolts as we pull in.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No problem! Paimon's always floating, so a few bumps won't scare Paimon!
